comment: SSOT for the review-finding severity model. `gating` lists the severities whose findings the reviewer anchors to a line even when it cannot find one, so a caller's merge gate can hold the merge on the thread; `icons` maps every severity to the emoji its posted finding leads with. A non-gating finding that cannot be anchored spills into the review body instead. Consumer: .github/reviewer/post-pr-review.mjs (renders findings, stamps the hidden `<!-- severity: ... -->` marker). Editing this file changes review behavior with no code change.
